name: Noah LaLonde
bio: Noah LaLonde is an actor, known for his work in My Life with the Walter Boys, Criminal Minds (2022), and Deer Camp '86 (2022).

credits.title: Guarding Stars
credits.overview: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

credits.title: Deer Camp '86
credits.overview: In the fall of 1986, six knuckleheads from Detroit travel north to partake in the annual tradition of deer hunting. But something horrific has been awakened and the hunters become the hunted.

credits.title: Asbury Park
credits.overview: We're in the midst of a revolution. With protests and uprisings taking place all over the world in the name of justice, we find ourselves in a time where the world is finally ready to hear the voice of the inner city. Asbury Park echoes that voice, revealing a tale of injustice through the eyes of four inner-city youth
